product.name: Monoprice Super VGA (SVGA) M/F Monitor Cable with Ferrite Cores Gold Plated 6ft
product.description: Extend your SVGA monitor cable using this Super VGA Monitor Extension Cable from Monoprice!This double-shielded cable is designed to handle analog VGA and extended VGA resolutions. It features a male DE-15 (aka HD-15 or DB-15) connector on one end and a female DE-15 connector on the other end. Each heavy duty connector head includes thumbscrews for securing the plug to a panel connector. It includes ferrite cores at each end, which ensure that EMI and RFI interference will not enter your video system.Updated Sep 4, 2019  Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
